title: Captions: presets, how to choose, how to tweak so no two videos match

entries.when: face + overlay style, tutorial or tool talk, a technical voice
entries.do: Mono caps in a dark rounded pill sitting on the seam between the overlay and the face (y 40-50 %); 2-4 words per page; the pill grows to fit; accent only on the current word.

evidence.note: 'MAKE 100 VERSIONS', 'ARENA SKILL' in a mono dark pill on the seam

how_by_engine.2d-flat: Captions.tsx boxed preset with mono font
how_by_engine.board: bottom pill instead of the seam

entries.when: story and dialogue shorts, fast speech, flat or 3D stickman and Roblox
entries.do: One to three words at a time, heavy sans, white with black stroke; exactly one keyword per phrase in yellow; a 90 to 100 % scale bounce on entry, nothing on exit; y 64-70 %.

evidence.note: bold white caps, yellow keyword, y 70 %
one word at a time, thick outline, y 64 %

entries.do: A full sentence, 1-2 lines, soft white sans with a 20-30 % shadow and a faint glow; no box; fades in by line, not by word; y 45-50 % when cards sit below, 70 % otherwise.

evidence.note: sentence captions over the mascot, y about 45 %
speaker tag CLAUDE / YOU over the caption

anti_patterns: glow so strong the text blurs

entries.when: host-led explainers, voxel/Roblox hosts, any line with a tool or number to remember
entries.do: Clean sans, one line; the emphasis word gets a rounded colour box (green or orange) behind it, drawn in 120 ms; the box colour comes from the style palette accent; the other words stay plain white.

entries.when: board explainers and any line that is a punch with a lead-in
entries.do: Two parts: a small grey lead-in (the setup) above, the punch in huge heavy caps below with one coloured word; they enter 150 ms apart; the headline is at most 4 words.

evidence.note: 'ek developer ne aisa project banaya...' small, 'ANTHROPIC KE CEO BHI' huge with red word
light sentence with a blue keyword, big numeral below

entries.when: two-person dialogue without voice, or any quoted line
entries.do: Small white sans in quotes, top third; aligned left when the left character speaks and shifted right when the right one speaks; the previous line fades 300 ms before the next; the payoff line is 1.6x bigger and bolder.

evidence.note: 'Twenty years downstream.' large after small quoted lines
lines placed left or right with the speaker
two lines on screen when the second answers

entries.when: always: the style needs its own caption signature, not a copy
entries.do: Add one signature to every preset: ink-drip underline that draws under the emphasis word (stickman), ticker-tape strip for dashboards, torn-paper label for notebook styles, pixel-bit shimmer for voxel. One signature per video, 300-450 ms.

evidence.note: none of the 27 references share a signature; ours differ on purpose (upgrade rule)

entries.when: choosing and tweaking a preset for a new video
entries.do: 1) filter presets by style; 2) rank by content type (tutorial, story, dialogue, numbers) and dominant emotion (calm, tense, funny, shocking); 3) tweak: accent colour from the project palette, weight by energy (calm 500, loud 800), words per page by speech rate (fast speech means fewer words), y by the layout safe zone; 4) reject if the same preset + accent + font as any of the last 5 projects; 5) name it and log it in project/captions-choice.json.

evidence.note: caption looks change inside one video (serif-italic keyword, green highlight, plain white) so presets should carry variants

anti_patterns: the default preset on every project

entries.do: Score each word: number or currency +3, negation +3, tool/brand/proper noun +2, change verb (fix, break, cut, double) +2, superlative or absolute (free, every, never, only) +2, first word of the sentence +1; take the top word per phrase above 2; never emphasise stop words; the emphasis must match the overlay keyword on screen when one exists.
